goal: Review one supplied manuscript through the current typed research_harness engine and reach a COMPLETED Review.
limitations: One Recipe (paper-review), one synthetic manuscript, one topic.
Proves execution-integrity and contract-acceptance for this run only; NOT research quality, novelty, or exhaustive-retrieval validation.
A COMPLETED run and a PASS scorecard are contract signals, never a truth claim about the review's correctness.
Not expert reviewed; cross-topic and real-manuscript proof remain open.
Artifact hashes are content-addressed for this checkout; skill or manuscript changes will change them by design.
REVIEW_SCORECARD.json embeds a wall-clock generated_at; its recorded hash is over timestamp-normalized content, not the raw bytes.

produced_artifacts.hash_basis: sha256 over canonical JSON with `generated_at` normalized to '<normalized-for-reproducible-hash>'; the on-disk file embeds a wall-clock `generated_at` (tooling.common.now_iso_seconds -> datetime.now), so a plain sha256sum of the raw file will differ by design.

verification.novelty_matrix_grounded: positioned claims against the manuscript reference list rather than emitting the 'related works unavailable' fallback.
verification.real_skills: producer skills (manuscript-ingest, claims-extractor, evidence-auditor, novelty-matrix, rubric-writer) plus the artifact-contract-auditor ran as subprocesses; no stub adapters.
